correctness.rationale: The graph equivalence is given by a complete orientation argument, irreducibility forces a connected leafless graph with e=v+1, and degree counting forces occupied shore sizes to differ by at most one. This proves the sharp rectangular upper bounds and exceptional cases. Disjoint theta-path constructions produce all even sizes; alternating even cycles with an unused chord produce all odd sizes. Deleting any theta edge leaves a pseudoforest. The exact-size nuance is disclosed. Packaged checker independently tests 71,636 tracked diagnostic checks, including direct team semantics and witnesses through t=40; finiteness is not substituted for proof.
